Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class SharedGameTestSupport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.SharedGameTestSupport
Direct Known Subclasses:
GameTestSupport
abstract class SharedGameTestSupport extends Object
Supplies vanilla and loader-neutral setup and assertions to both GameTest suites.

    • refuseProtection

      static SharedGameTestSupport.RefusalScope refuseProtection(SharedGameTestSupport.ProtectionRefusal refusal)
      Refuses the loader protection events refusal selects until the returned scope closes. Each loader's test listeners, registered once on its event buses, consult every open scope, since tests in a batch run concurrently and a scope may stay open across ticks.
